chapter: Recollections of Trent's band and its influence
title: The Gunter Roof in San Antonio: Clara Bow and Buddy Rogers
summary: At the Gunter Hotel in 1926 the film stars of Wings sit near the bandstand.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: Another thing that I would like to emphasize, some incidents that happened with Trent when we were playing the Adolphus Hotel, that was naturally, of course, in '25. Paul Whiteman came--
I remember, you told me that. That we got on the first tape.
No, no. I don't remember that.
We were playing at the Gunner Hotel--
In San Antonio; that came up in '26. We were playing at the Gunner Roof and Clara Beau and Buddy Rogers--they were making the movie.

Yeah, they were making "Wings". That's where they made it. After they got through it, the set each day, they would come to the Gunner Roof and they had a table reserved over by me and I used to like that.
We talked about that when he was through here about four years ago, and he remembered me, he said you're that little guy who was playing
that trombone down in San Antonio.
